# @first-iraqi-bank/sdk

[![npm version](https://badge.fury.io/js/@first-iraqi-bank%2Fsdk.svg)](https://badge.fury.io/js/@first-iraqi-bank%2Fsdk)

First Iraqi Bank allows you to create online payments in your application using [Rest API](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/18377702/UVCB93tc).

This package helps you integrate the payment API easily on your JavaScript/TypeScript backend server with simple and typed set of functions.

Please read our [Documentation](https://first-iraqi-bank.github.io/fib-nodejs-payment-sdk/) for a smooth integration.
